source: 783 Boarding the Ship
target: 783 In Navem Conscendens

source: 783 Boarding the Ship
target: 783 In Navem Conscendens

source: Banamo Port, near the docks.
target: Portus Banamo, iuxta navalia.

source: Jenna hid in the shadows, watching Anthony mingle with the crowd, blending in with the pirates.
target: Jenna in umbris se abscondit, spectans Anthonium cum turba miscere et inter piratas se assimilare.

source: She didn’t deliberately track the famous pirates who arrived on the Newins when it docked.
target: Non diligenter vestigia piratorum famosos sequeretur qui in Newins advenerunt cum navis ad portum accessit.

source: On the one hand, she feared being discovered, which would alert Admiral Deep Sea to a grand consOriginal awaiting him at Banamo Port.
target: Ex una parte, timebat ne detegeretur, quod Admiralem Profundum Mare de magno consOriginal, qui eum in Portu Banamo exspectabat, admoneret.

source: On the other hand, she didn’t need to follow them to know the whereabouts of the Newins’ first mate, second mate, and boatswain.
target: Ex altera parte, non opus erat eos sequi ut locum primi ministri, secundi ministri, et navarchi Newins cognosceret.

source: The pirates in Banamo Port were eagerly anticipating Admiral Deep Sea or his capable subordinates to teach the unknown adventurer a lesson.
target: Piratae in Portu Banamo ardenter exspectabant Admiralem Profundum Mare aut eius capaces subditos ad disciplinam ignoti viatoris tradendam.

source: Naturally, they kept an eye on these individuals and shared information with their companions and friends!
target: Naturaliter, illos vigilabant et notitias cum sociis ac amicis communicabant!

source: In other words, with so much attention on the situation, most of the pirates in Banamo Port had become unofficial reporters.
target: Aliis verbis, cum tanta attentione ad rem, plerique piratae in Portu Banamo facti erant nuntiatores extra officiales.

source: Admiral Deep Sea’s key subordinates couldn’t go anywhere without being noticed and widely discussed.
target: Principales ministri Admiralis Profundi Maris nusquam abire poterant, quippe si eorum motus animadvertere et late disseri non posset.

source: If they used stealth abilities or invisibility, they might avoid the curious eyes spread throughout Banamo Port.
target: Si facultates furtivas aut invisibilitatem adhiberent, oculi curiosi per Portum Banamo diffusi eis evitare poterant.

source: However, they were currently gathering supplies, which meant they couldn’t hide the large quantities of goods.
target: Attamen, nunc suppellectilem colligebant, quod significabat se magnas copias bonorum celare non posse.

source: Thus, information flowed swiftly into Anthony’s ears: “Great Shark is at Firth Trading Company.”
target: Itaque notitia celeriter in aures Anthoni inflavit: “Magnus Squalus apud Firth Trading Company adest.”

source: “Ship Destroyer is heading towards the Carnival Bar!”
target: “Nāvem Destructor ad Tabernam Carnivales se dirigit!”

source: “Holy Lord of Storms, those guys are meeting at Blackstone Square!”
target: “Sancte Domine Tempestatum, illi in Platea Nigrī Lapidis conveniunt!”

source: “They’re one street away from the Carnival Bar!”
target: “Ab Taberna Carnivales una via distant!”

source: “They’ve stopped for now, discussing something!”
target: “Iam subsiderunt, aliquid disserentes!”

source: “They seem to be heading to Old Dante’s for large barrels of pale ale!”
target: “Videtur eos ire ad Antiquum Dante pro magnis dolis cervisiae pallidae!”

source: Anthony sensed the commotion among the pirates, watching them leave the current street and head towards the Carnival Bar.
target: Anthony tumultum inter piratas sensit, eos spectans eā via recedere et ad Tabernam Carnivales contendere.

source: He stood up as well to avoid standing out.
target: Et ipse surrexit, ne eminens appareret.

source: During this, he gave Jenna’s hidden shadow a look.
target: In hoc, oculos in umbram Jennæ latentem contulit.

source: Jenna understood immediately, using the shadows along the street to slip through the growing crowd towards the Carnival Bar.
target: Jenna statim intellexit, umbras per viam adhibens ut per turbam crescente ad Tabernam Carnivales se furtim moveret.

source: Lumian sipped the freshly poured amber-colored Lanti Proof, nodding to himself.
target: Lumian Lanti Proof, recentissime effusum et colore amberei inditum, sorbuit, sibi annuens.

source: He then looked at the bartender behind the counter, smiling as he said, “You might want to move the valuable liquor and items out of here for now. It’s probably best if no one stays inside.”
target: Deinde ad cauponem post tabulatum spectavit, subridens, dicens: “Forsitan velis liquorem pretiosum et res hinc interim transferre; optimum erit si nemo intus maneat.”

source: The bartender froze for a few seconds before responding hastily, “Alright!”
target: Caupo paucis momentis stetit, deinde celerrime respondit: “Ita!”

source: No one wanted to alert Lumian by passing on messages that might affect the plan, but he guessed something was brewing from the pirates gathering outside the bar.
target: Nemo voluit Lumian admonere per nuntios tradendos, qui consilium afficere possent, sed ipse suspicatus est aliquid e piratis extra tabernam congregatis fieri.

source: He was both excited and nervous, knowing the impending conflict would take place in the Carnival Bar, where he was.
target: Et exsultans et anxius erat, sciens proelium imminens in Tabernam Carnivales futurum esse, ubi ipse se inveniebat.

source: Watching the bartender instruct the waiters to move valuable items out the back door, Lumian pulled out a blank sketchbook and an ink pen, casually sketching as he asked, “How much is your bar worth, including this two-story building?”
target: Cauponem spectans qui ministris imperabat ut res pretiosas per ostium posticum moverent, Lumian librum delineandi vacuum et calamus extraxit, leviter depingens ac rogans: “Quantum valet taberna tua, hoc aedificio duorum stratorum includendo?”

source: “Uh…” The bartender was stunned again.
target: “Eheu…” Caupo iterum attonitus fuit.

source: What does this mean?
target: Quid hoc significat?

source: Is he implying the bar might get destroyed in the upcoming conflict, collapsing the whole building?
target: Num insinuat tabernam in proximo proelio delebitur, totum aedificium corruens?

source: Recalling the powerful crimson-white fireballs, the bartender grew even more anxious, forcing a smile as he said, “Are you offering compensation? You decide, or let the loser pay…”
target: Memor potentium globulorum ignis rubro-albore, caupo magis anxius factus est, subridens cogens et dicens: “An compensatio tua est? Tu decernas, aut sinas ut qui perit solvat...”

source: “This building is a simple structure built by locals. It’s definitely cheap. Your bar caters to low-level pirates, so the furniture and décor are all the cheapest kind…” Lumian continued his assessment without looking up, still sketching in the blank book.
target: “Hoc aedificium est structura simplex ab incolis aedificata. Certe vilis est. Tua taberna ad piratas humilis gradus destinata est, ideo supellex et ornamenta omne genere vilissima sunt…” Lumian aestimationem suam continuavit sine sursum aspiciens, adhuc in libro vacuo depingens.

source: “Yes, that’s right.” The bartender nodded quickly, agreeing.
target: “Ita, recte est.” Caupo celeriter annuit.

source: Lumian looked up, shaking his head with a smile. “Whatever I say, you agree. It’s making things difficult for me.”
target: Lumian surrexit, caput agitando ac subridens: “Quaecumque dicam, tu assentiris. Ea mihi difficultates afferunt.”

source: “…” The bartender closed his mouth, unsure how to respond.
target: “…” Caupo os clausit, nescius quo respondeat.

source: Lumian lowered his head again. “How about 2,000 verl d’or?”
target: Lumian caput iterum inclinavit: “Quid de 2,000 verl d’or?”

source: “Okay.” The bartender used a different word, not even trying to bargain.
target: “Bene.” Caupo alterum verbum usus est, neque quidem de negotiatione conatus.

source: Lumian didn’t pause his sketching, his tone calm.
target: Lumian delineationem suam non intermittebat, tono tranquillo.

source: “Payment will be after assessing the damage. If the big pirates coming later want to help compensate, that works too.”
target: “Solutio erit post aestimationem damni. Si magni piratae, qui postea venerint, compensare auxilio studuerint, id quoque valet.”

source: “Alright.” The bartender responded quickly.
target: “Ita.” Caupo celeriter respondit.

source: He looked around, wishing he could sprout wings and fly out of the Carnival Bar.
target: Circumspiciens, optabat se alae gerere posse atque ex Tabernā Carnivālēs evadere.

source: From their conversation, he feared staying could lead to him becoming a mangled corpse.
target: Ex eorum colloquio timebat manere posse eum in cadaver laceratum convertere.

source: A few minutes later, the waiters had moved the few valuable items out, leaving only the cheap goods in the bar.
target: Paucis minutis post, ministri paucas res pretiosas extra moverant, relinquentes in taberna solum mercimonia vilia.

source: The bartender left through the back door, and the other patrons, including Mason, exited to wait and watch outside.
target: Caupo per ostium posticum exiit, et ceteri clientes, inter quos Mason etiam, foris exierunt ut exspectarent et spectarent.

source: They didn’t dare stay in this anticipated battlefield.
target: Non ausi sunt manere in hoc proelio exspectato.

source: This was the lesson of experience.
target: Hoc erat praeceptum experientiae.

source: Lumian sketched for a while, then put down his pen and slowly sipped the remaining Lanti Proof.
target: Lumian paulisper delineavit, deinde calamus deiecit et lente reliquum Lanti Proof sorbuit.

source: A few minutes later, Franca sneaked into the shadows near the bar and whispered, “Admiral Deep Sea didn’t come, but his first mate, Great Shark, and others are almost here. They’ll be here in about two minutes.”
target: Paucis minutis post, Franca ad umbras prope tabernam se furtim inserebat et susurravit: “Admiralis Profundus Mare non venit, sed primus socius eius, Magnus Squalus, et alii paene adsunt. Ibi erunt circa duos minutos.”

source: Lumian picked up the ink pen again and continued sketching in the book.
target: Lumian iterum calamus sumpsit et in libro delineare continuavit.

source: He chuckled and said, “Remember to prepare the 2,000 verl d’or compensation, and when we get back, return the 1,000 verl d’or bounty for summoning the messenger.”
target: Risus emisit et dixit: “Memento compensationem 2,000 verl d’or praeparare, et cum redeamus, redde 1,000 verl d’or praemium pro nuntio evocando.”

source: “Ah?” Franca was a bit surprised.
target: “Ah?” Franca paulo mirata est.

source: Lumian chuckled and said, “All of this is to help you digest Pleasure. You should cover all expenses, including consumed Beyonder items.”
target: Lumian risit et dixit: “Hoc omnia est ut tibi auxilii sit ad Voluptatem digerendam. Oportet omnes expensas sustinere, inclusis rebus Beyonder consumptis.”

source: “No problem.” Franca wasn’t resisting; she was just surprised Lumian brought it up suddenly.
target: “Nulla quaestio.” Franca non resistebat; modo mirabatur quod Lumian subito id attulerit.

source: She watched Lumian finish his sketch on the blank page, curious as she asked, “Why not just take out the Pride Armor, disguise it as a person with a robe, and have it sit in this chair facing away from the incoming pirates?”
target: Illa spectavit Lumian delineare finem sui in pagina vacua, curiosa rogans: “Cur non tollis Armaturam Superbiæ, eam ut hominem cum togā simulare, et in hac sella sedere disponas, ita ut facies eius a piratis venturis avertatur?”

source: With Lumian present, the Pride Armor couldn’t be used, so it might as well serve some purpose by being placed here.
target: Cum Lumian praesens esset, Armatura Superbiæ uti non poterat; igitur melius aliqua utilitas esset, si hic collocaretur.

source: “Do you really want this building destroyed?” Lumian chuckled. “Besides, the Pride Armor can’t use Lie and can’t disguise itself as me. The subordinates of Admiral Deep Sea would notice something’s wrong before even entering.”
target: “Num vere vis hunc aedificium deletum esse?” Lumian risit. “Praeterea, Armatura Superbiæ mendacium uti nequeat neque se in me transformare. Subditi Admiralis Profundi Maris aliquid iniuriosum animadverterent antequam intrarent.”

source: As he spoke, Lumian finished the last stroke on the blank page.
target: Dum loquebatur, Lumian ultimam lineam in pagina vacua perficit.

source: It was a sketch outlined in deep blue ink, depicting Lumian himself.
target: Erat delineatio delineata atri caerulei tincta, quae Lumian ipsum repraesentabat.

source: The paper gradually turned translucent, and the sketch of Lumian suddenly came to life, thickening and expanding like a balloon.
target: Charta paulatim translucens facta est, atque delineatio Lumiani subito in vitam evasit, crassior et dilatans velut globus.

source: In an instant, a stoic-faced Lumian appeared before the bar counter, blocked by Lumian’s body.
target: In momento, Lumian vultu stoico ante mensam tabernae apparuit, corpore Lumiani obstructus.

source: It had the instinct to complete a few minutes of combat and possessed some of Lumian’s abilities, obeying the sketcher’s commands.
target: Illi ingenium erat ut paucos momenta proelii peragret et nonnullas virtutes Lumiani haberet, praeceptoris delineatoris obsequens.

source: As the sketched Lumian sat in a chair facing away from the bar door, Lumian transformed into a shadow creature, disappearing from the bar.
target: Dum delineatus Lumian in sella sedebat, a porta tabernae se avertens, Lumian in creaturam umbræ transformatus est, ex taberna evanescens.

source: Soon, Great Shark, the first mate of the Newins, arrived at the Carnival Bar with a few companions of similar strength, surrounded by a crowd of pirates.
target: Mox Magnus Squalus, primus socius Newins, cum paucis comitibus simillimis viribus ad Tabernam Carnivales pervenit, a turba piratarum circumdatus.

source: The tall, muscular, bald Great Shark glanced at the unknown adventurer calmly sitting at the bar and gestured, leading the way through the door.
target: Magnus Squalus, altus, musculus, calvus, viatorem ignotum quiescentem ad tabernam intuerebat et gesticulans iter per ostium monstravit.

source: As the Beyonders from the Newins entered the bar, Lumian, disguised and watching from the window, placed his right hand on the glass.
target: Dum Beyonders e Newins tabernam intrabant, Lumian, celatus et ex fenestra spectans, dextram manum in vitrum imposuit.

source: A black mark hidden under his clothes glowed.
target: Nigrum signum sub vestimentis absconditum lucide fulgebat.

source: Bottle of Fiction!
target: Vas Fictionis!

source: He trapped the Carnival Bar inside the Bottle of Fiction, setting the condition for exit to be non-Beyonders.
target: Tabernam Carnivales in Vas Fictionis recludit, condicionem exitus constituens ut non ex Beyonders esset.

source: Lumian turned, and in the chaos of the pirates losing sight of the bar’s interior, he squeezed through the crowd and headed to a nearby alley, teleporting to the docks with Franca.
target: Lumian conversus est, et in confusione piratarum interiora tabernae obliviscientium, per turbam se comprimit atque ad proximam angustum viam contendit, cum Franca ad navalia teleportans.

source: They met Jenna and Anthony at the designated spot, using shadows and Psychological Invisibility to remain hidden as they boarded the alchemical ship Newins.
target: Ipsi convenere cum Jennā et Anthoni in loco designato, umbras atque invisibilitatem psychologicam adhibentes ut absconditi remanserent, dum navem alchemicam Newins conscenderent.

source: Compared to when they arrived, there were fewer pirates on the ship, just enough to maintain basic vigilance.
target: Comparatis temporibus adventus, pauciores piratae in navi erant, satis tantum ad vigilantiam rudimentariam conservandam.

source: Lumian wasn’t worried their actions would alert Admiral Deep Sea.
target: Lumian non sollicitus erat ne eorum acta Admiralem Profundum Mare admonerent.

source: According to gathered intel, Howl Constantine wasn’t a Beyonder of the Devil pathway and couldn’t sense malice.
target: Secundum notitias collectas, Howl Constantine non fuit Beyonder viae Diaboli et malitiam sentire non potuit.

source: His abilities resembled a Sequence 5 Ocean Songster of the Storm pathway, and according to the Tarot Club, Admiral Deep Sea had no ties to the Church of Storms.
target: Eius potentiae similes erant Sequenciae 5 Ocean Songster (via Tempestatum), et secundum Tarot Club, Admiralis Profundus Mare nullos nexūs ad Ecclesiam Tempestatum habebat.

source: Thus, Lumian had Jenna confirm if the Black Octopus had followed the Newins to Banamo Port—the Black Octopus’s captain, Bone Splitter Basil, was a Devil.
target: Ita, Lumian iussit Jennam verificare, si Octopus Niger Newins sequeretur ad Portum Banamo—capitaneus Octopi Nigri, Bone Splitter Basil, Diabolus erat.

source: Considering the changing situation at the Carnival Bar might alert Admiral Deep Sea, Lumian and his team didn’t waste time, swiftly sneaking into the ship’s hold.
target: Quoniam mutatio rei in Tabernā Carnivālēs Admiralem Profundum Mare admonere posset, Lumian et turma eius tempus non perdiderunt, celeriter in cellam navis se insidiantes.

source: Within a minute, they found a lone pirate in a corridor room.
target: Intra minuto, in conclavi corridori invenerunt unicum piratam.

source: Franca checked the surrounding mechanical devices for alarms, then whispered to shadow-form Lumian, “It’s show time.”
target: Franca machinas mechanicas circumstantium pro sonis periculum examinavit, deinde Lumiano, in forma umbrā, susurravit: “Tempus spectaculi est.”

source: Lumian immediately slipped into the room, moving behind the lone pirate and emerging, giving a harrumph.
target: Lumian statim in conclave se introduxit, post unicum piratam movens et emergens, gutturim exclamans “harrumph.”

source: Two flashes of white light, and the pirate fell unconscious.
target: Duae micationes luminis albi, et pirata in insensibilitatem cecidit.

source: Anthony entered the room quickly, beginning hypnosis.
target: Anthony celeriter in conclave intravit, hypnosi initium faciens.

source: Jenna and Franca guarded the door from the shadows, soon hearing friendly conversation inside, “Where’s the Admiral?”
target: Jenna et Franca ostium ex umbris custodiēbant, mox audientes amicam sermonem intus: “Ubi est Admiralis?”

source: “In the captain’s cabin.”
target: “In cubiculo capitani.”

source: “The Admiral must have a powerful backer to be one of the most famous pirates, right?”
target: “Admiralis certe validum patronum habere debet, ut unus ex piratis celebrioribus sit, nonne?”

source: “I don’t know, but the Admiral is indeed mysterious.”
target: “Nescio, sed Admiralis vere mysteriosus est.”

source: After a brief inquiry, Anthony made the pirate forget he had such a friend on board.
target: Post breve quaestionem, Anthony fecit ut pirata oblivisceretur se talem amicum in nave habere.

source: They then sneaked to the upper deck, stopping outside the captain’s cabin.
target: Tum furtim ad terram superiorem se contulerunt, foris cubiculi capitani subsistentes.

source: Lumian’s eyes twitched as he gazed at the silver‑white metal door.
target: Oculi Lumiani micabant, dum portas metallarum argenteo-albas intuebatur.

source: He realized Admiral Deep Sea’s possible pathway and sequence.
target: Animadvertit viam et ordinem Admiralis Profundi Maris.

source: On an alchemical ship like this, an Ocean Songster’s power might not be inferior to being in the deep sea or the air!
target: In navis alchemica huiusmodi, potentia Ocean Songster non minor esse potest quam in profundo mari aut in aere!

source: While Lumian pondered, two pirates pushed a food cart to the captain’s cabin using a mechanical lift.
target: Dum Lumian cogitabat, duo piratae plaustrum cum cibo ad cubiculum capitani impulerunt, utens machina levatoria.
